# Felix Keuya Renewable Energy and Project Finance Analyst

Felix Keuya provides fixed-scope and white-label analyst support to renewable energy developers, investors, lenders, advisory firms, EPCs and energy platforms across Africa and emerging markets.

Canonical website: https://felixkeuya.com/
Location: Nairobi, Kenya
Contact: felixkeuya@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/felix-keuya/
About Felix: https://felixkeuya.com/about.html

## Core services

- Renewable energy project finance analysis: https://felixkeuya.com/services/renewable-energy-project-finance-africa.html
  - Project screening, financial model review, debt sizing, CFADS, DSCR, LLCR, PLCR, PPA analysis, sensitivities, lender-style risk review and investment decision support.
- Solar PV and BESS financial modelling: https://felixkeuya.com/services/solar-bess-financial-modelling.html
  - Revenue, CAPEX/OPEX, storage assumptions, debt schedules, reserve accounts, repayment profiles, IRR and downside cases.
- PPA and wheeling financial analysis: https://felixkeuya.com/services/ppa-wheeling-analysis-africa.html
  - Tariffs, network charges, losses, residual supply, buyer savings, generator returns and curtailment analysis.
- Renewable energy market due diligence: https://felixkeuya.com/services/renewable-energy-market-due-diligence-africa.html
  - Regulation, tariffs, demand, grid constraints, offtaker risk, procurement, project pipelines and financing conditions.
- White-label renewable energy analyst support: https://felixkeuya.com/services/white-label-energy-analyst-support.html
  - Confidential models, research, investment memos, project screening, databases and presentations for client teams.

## Practical project finance insights

Insights hub: https://felixkeuya.com/insights.html

- Solar project finance model: CFADS, DSCR and debt sizing: https://felixkeuya.com/insights/solar-project-finance-model-dscr-cfads.html
  - How contracted revenue becomes CFADS, debt capacity and lender-style coverage analysis.
- What makes a renewable energy PPA bankable in Africa?: https://felixkeuya.com/insights/bankable-renewable-energy-ppa-africa.html
  - Revenue certainty, payment security, curtailment, termination, currency and contract risk allocation.
- South Africa corporate PPA wheeling economics: https://felixkeuya.com/insights/south-africa-corporate-ppa-wheeling-economics.html
  - TOU matching, losses, network charges, residual supply, buyer savings and generator economics.
- BESS project finance modelling: https://felixkeuya.com/insights/bess-project-finance-modelling.html
  - Usable capacity, round-trip efficiency, degradation, cycling, augmentation, revenue and debt-service impact.
- Offtaker and payment risk in African renewable energy: https://felixkeuya.com/insights/offtaker-payment-risk-africa-renewables.html
  - Buyer credit quality, payment history, security instruments, delay scenarios, termination support and currency risk.

## Positioning

Felix Keuya combines an electrical and electronic engineering foundation with renewable energy project finance, commercial diligence and power-market analysis. The portfolio is intended for renewable energy developers, infrastructure investors, lenders, advisers, specialist consultancies and energy platforms that need practical project finance or analyst support.
